title: ECC SETKEY: no P-256 minimum — P-192 keys silently imported to device
description: Trigger: wc_ecc_init_ex(&key, NULL, WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID) then wc_ecc_import_private_key with a P-192 private scalar (field_sz=24). Path: SETKEY callback → WC_SETKEY_ECC_PRIV case → field_sz = info->setkey.keySz (24) → crypto2dev_key_import('ecdsa', CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_PRIVATE, raw, 24). The guard checks field_sz == 0 || field_sz > ECC_MAXSIZE but has no minimum. Bad outcome: if the kernel device accepts P-192, subsequent ECDSA operations use a below-minimum curve. FIPS 140-3 IG D.1 requires P-256 minimum for ECDSA. Fix: add field_sz < 32 → CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE in WC_SETKEY_ECC_PRIV and WC_SETKEY_ECC_PUB cases.
